prompts: Create a production four-frame walk cycle sprite sheet for Lumine, using the supplied MASTER only as the exact character/model/style reference. Transparent background. 4 full-body sprites in ONE horizontal row, equal 384px-wide cells, all facing screen RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view as the master. Natural 6.5-head-tall proportions, small head EXACTLY like master, same white blue gold outfit, identical hair and boots. Right hand wraps around sword hilt with fingers behind guard, blade points down-right in every frame, rigid sword follows wrist without changing hand. Left arm small counter swing. Exactly FOUR DISTINCT gait phases in temporal order, essential: FRAME1 CONTACT left leg extended FORWARD toward screen right, left heel touches ground, right leg BEHIND toward screen left toe touching ground, both knees almost straight, wide V silhouette; FRAME2 PASSING left planted support leg under pelvis, right SWING leg flexed at knee and lifted, right ankle passing beside left shin, feet close under body, narrow silhouette; FRAME3 OPPOSITE CONTACT right leg forward toward screen right heel grounded, left leg behind toward screen left toe grounded, reversed leg depth/occlusion compared with frame1, wide V silhouette; FRAME4 OPPOSITE PASSING right support leg under pelvis, left swing knee flexed and lifted foot passing beside support shin, narrow silhouette, reversed leg depth/occlusion versus frame2. Legs must alternate, NOT four lunges or four standing poses. Knee bends belong to swing leg only; planted support boot sits on identical ground baseline across all cells. Head center X exactly at each cell center, head height and torso size consistent, head bob no more than 1% body height. Hip above support foot on passing poses. Preserve long legs and recognizable boots, do NOT enlarge head. Modest walking stride, NOT run, no flight phase, no crouching. Cloth shows underlying leg silhouette, not hiding ankles or knees. Same 335px logical full body height when scaled for game; crisp simplified pixel-art clusters suited to 16-color quantization, not chibi. Full sword, cape and body contained with generous empty cell padding. NO text, labels, arrows, ground shadows, frames or scenery.

Correct ONLY gait anatomy on the attached four-frame Lumine walk cycle. Keep exactly same sheet size/layout, character designs and tiny head proportions. Four sequential frames must not repeat the same legs. Frame1 and Frame2 leave unchanged. In frame3 CHANGE near-camera leg (the leg attaching to the visible near hip at screen right of pelvis) so its thigh angles BACKWARD toward screen LEFT, its knee is at screen LEFT of pelvis, and its boot is grounded at the LEFT rear. The FAR leg crosses behind that thigh and extends forward toward screen RIGHT with a straight knee and forward grounded heel. This must clearly invert the visible thigh/knee occlusion of frame1, not just change boot decoration. In frame4 CHANGE near-camera leg: this leg is now the SWING leg, its thigh swings FORWARD toward screen RIGHT with knee lifted in front at screen RIGHT of pelvis, knee bent 40 degrees, shin down-and-back to airborne foot beside opposite calf. The FAR leg is straight supporting body with grounded foot directly under pelvis. Frame2 has its near leg planted and far leg swinging; frame4 must have its near leg swinging and far leg planted. Keep both contact legs slightly bent anatomically, natural short walk. Keep sword grip and upper body fixed. True transparent background. No text, no added figures. Need visible alternating left-right leg identity, four distinct silhouettes, NOT identical frame1/frame3 and identical frame2/frame4.

Precise correction to this 4-frame sprite sheet, transparent. Keep exact four-cell layout, all four body sizes, all body silhouettes and sword grips. TWO changes only. 1) Reduce the HEAD including hair/face/flower in every sprite to 80 percent of its current size, keep head bottom connected naturally to the same neck location, no changes to torso or legs. Character must have mother-reference long-leg natural proportions, not oversized pixel chibi head. 2) Fourth/rightmost sprite ONLY: lower its raised forward knee from the current high running march position to a restrained walking passing position: near thigh almost vertical with knee only 5% of full body height in front of pelvis, knee only bent about30degrees, swing ankle only 5-8% full body height above ground and next to the planted shin. Keep forward swing leg in front of support leg and maintain alternation from frame2. Not high knee, not running, not hopping. Keep frame1/2/3 leg geometry unchanged. No text, shadows or scenery.
